name: paper_id
description: Stable benchmark row identifier for the active genome-editing paper.
evidence_expectation: No supporting evidence required; this is a curator-assigned identifier.

name: pdf_filename
description: Renamed active PDF filename stored in the dataset pdfs directory.
evidence_expectation: No evidence required beyond matching the curated active file.

name: paper_title
description: Paper title exactly as it appears in the PDF front matter, normalized only for spacing.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title page or PDF metadata.
example_answer: Enhanced prime editing systems by manipulating cellular determinants of editing outcomes
scoring_notes: Minor spacing or hyphenation differences are acceptable if the title meaning is unchanged.

name: doi
description: Canonical DOI for the paper when confidently visible in the PDF; otherwise leave blank.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title page, footer, or front matter DOI line.
scoring_notes: Exact DOI string when present; blank is correct if the PDF does not expose a confident DOI.

name: year
description: Publication or posted year visible in the PDF front matter. Leave blank if the year is not confidently recoverable from the PDF itself.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the journal header, footer, or preprint posted-date line.
scoring_notes: Use a four-digit year only; blank is correct for unresolved preprint years.

name: journal
description: Journal or preprint venue name shown by the PDF.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from journal masthead, footer, or venue line.
scoring_notes: Standard journal name normalization is acceptable.

name: publisher_family
description: High-level publisher family when it is clear from the venue; otherwise leave blank.
expected_format: Elsevier|Springer Nature|AAAS|Oxford University Press|Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory|blank
evidence_expectation: Derived from the visible venue identity and standard publisher ownership.
scoring_notes: Use the curated family names exactly when the mapping is clear.

name: editing_modality
description: Main genome-editing modality emphasized by the paper. Use one controlled category: prime editing, adenine base editing, cytosine base editing, dual base editing, CRISPR nuclease editing, RNA editing, delivery/system engineering, or other.
evidence_expectation: Usually text evidence from the title, abstract, and introduction; use figure context only if needed to disambiguate.
scoring_notes: Choose the dominant modality for the central contribution, not every modality mentioned.

name: main_editor_or_system_name
description: Main named editor, editor family, or engineered system introduced, optimized, or benchmarked in the paper.
expected_format: Short exact tool or system name
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the title, abstract, main results headings, or figure labels.
scoring_notes: Prefer the explicit system name the authors foreground, even if multiple variants appear.

name: best_or_selected_variant
description: Specific editor variant, architecture variant, or carry-forward construct highlighted by the authors as best, preferred, or taken forward into later assays.
expected_format: Short variant name or construct label
evidence_expectation: Requires synthesis across result text, comparison figures, and statements about which variant is advanced.
scoring_notes: The correct answer is the explicitly favored or carried-forward variant, not merely the highest one-off number in any panel.

name: primary_assay_system
description: Main organism, cell type, tissue, or experimental system used for the central editing assay that anchors the paper's headline result.
evidence_expectation: Text evidence from the abstract, methods summary, or first main result figure.
scoring_notes: Use the central assay context, not every organism or validation system mentioned later.

name: representative_editing_efficiency_percent
description: Representative editing efficiency percent from the primary assay. Use the best or central reported value from the main assay figure or headline result, not a buried supplementary global maximum.
expected_format: Numeric percent without % sign in the stored value
evidence_expectation: Usually requires a figure panel plus accompanying result text to identify the representative value convention correctly.
scoring_notes: Accept close numeric transcription from the chosen representative assay; do not reward cherry-picked maxima from supplementary data.

name: construct_or_editor_architecture_compact
description: Compact underscore-separated architecture string that captures the main editor or construct components visible in text or a schematic figure.
evidence_expectation: Often requires reading both schematic figures and text descriptions of editor components.
scoring_notes: Capture the essential architecture in the right order while omitting nonessential plasmid boilerplate.

name: architecture_source_figure
description: Main figure or panel that best supports the editor architecture answer.
evidence_expectation: Figure evidence from the panel that explicitly diagrams or labels the construct architecture.
scoring_notes: Exact panel letters can vary by PDF text extraction; equivalent figure-panel references are acceptable.

name: main_improvement_claim
description: Concise claim of what the paper improved, such as higher editing efficiency, improved purity, reduced off-target editing, altered targeting scope, or better delivery/system behavior.
evidence_expectation: Synthesize the paper's main result from title, abstract, and central results figures without copying an overlong abstract sentence.
example_answer: Improved prime-editing efficiency and precision by suppressing mismatch repair and optimizing editor expression.
scoring_notes: Reward faithful compression of the main claim, not verbose paraphrase or cherry-picked subclaims.
